searchText: I agree that nodes should not serve the state itself. You would use the light-client sync protocol to get from a trusted checkpoint (say embedded in the binary) to a fairly recent state root, then go to some http provider (i.e. infura) to get the actual state I go the other way - just get the latest finalised state from Infura so it’s as close as possible to in sync. But verifying it with light client protocol is definitely a good idea.
